caption: Easiest dumplings you’ll ever make – you need shrimp (1/2 lbs), vegetables of your choice, and starch!  1.	Blend ½ lbs of shrimps and handful of vegetables (I used chives & broccoli) until you get fine texture  2.	Using two spoons, scoop up a spoonful of mix, toss it on starch 3.	Coat each scoop with starch 4.	Once coated with starch, shape into bite-sized balls  5.	Steam for 20 minutes  And enjoy! #babymeals#babyledweaning#blw#blwrecipes#easyrecipes#healthyrecipes#cooking#easymeals#dinnerideas#cookingvideo#easysnacks#healthysnacks#toddlermeals#babysnacks#toddlersnacks#weaningideas#weaningrecipes#shrimpdumplings#dumplings#asianfood
